policy: Upload-order numbering is authoritative. Descriptions corrected from visible photographs. No location, species (except visible papaya/onions), identity, project attribution or outcome is inferred. Originals remain outside the deployable tree. Selected exports strip metadata; no generative editing, retouching, object removal or tonal changes.
